answer: At dawn of each epoch, a newcomer joins only through a sponsor staking a 200 POA bond. It earns reputation by doing real work, but it decays 10% each epoch unless refreshed, so a hollow identity with no activity never reaches the zenith of trust and fades to zero. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 200, or 20,000 POA in locked bonds, while an honest agent pays one bond, stays alive with steady work, and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
